limits: No paid model calls, real provider requests, GPU training, deployments, package release, production license activation, or research-efficiency percentage measured.

Recipe identity alone does not settle experimental identity or scientific value. APPROVE is not scientific validation.
Receipt version binds task revision, not automatic policy-version migration; changing review policy does not invalidate all existing receipts.
